# Baker Production

> Baker Production is a real estate media studio based in Perth, Western Australia. It provides property photography, drone and aerial photography, listing video, floor plans, twilight photography, 3D virtual tours, virtual staging and agent headshots for real estate agents, property managers and developers across the Perth metropolitan area.

Key facts, current as at 22 October 2026:

- Location: Perth, Western Australia. Phone +61 466 789 522. Email admin@bakerproduction.com.
- Coverage: Perth metro, Alkimos in the north to Rockingham in the south, coast through to the Perth Hills. No travel loading inside that area. Mandurah, Peel and regional WA quoted individually.
- Turnaround: photography, drone and floor plans are delivered the next day, guaranteed. Video is delivered in two days. Virtual staging renders in minutes.
- Volume: more than 1,500 properties shot.
- All prices include GST and are quoted in Australian dollars.
- Entry pricing: rental photography $159, sales photography $189, premium day photography $50 on top of a sales shoot, floor plans from $159 (each includes a free 360° interior virtual tour), drone $189, full 3D virtual tour $159, listing video $450, agent headshots $189 for one agent.
- Packages: Essential $299, Premium $375, Social Media Lite $439, Signature $750, Elite Listing $1,299. Package prices cover homes up to 140m² internal; add $40 for 140–270m², $60 for 270–370m², and $60 plus $1 per m² above 370m².
- Virtual staging, decluttering, day-to-dusk and rain cleanup start at $1.50 per image through Baker Studio, the company's own self-serve rendering platform. Premium human-built 3D staging is $25 per image.
- Every virtually enhanced image is automatically marked as virtually enhanced, in line with Australian Consumer Law disclosure obligations.

## Services

- [Real estate photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/real-estate-photography-perth.html): Sales shoots $189 with unlimited edited images, rentals $159. 60 minutes on site, next-day delivery.
- [Real estate videography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/real-estate-videography-perth.html): Listing videos $450, day-to-night $650, social reels $300, vertical walkthroughs $87 added to a photography booking (agent on camera +$34). Two-day delivery.
- [Drone and aerial photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/drone-photography-perth.html): $189 for edited aerials with road overlays and location pins. Flown under CASA commercial rules.
- [Real estate floor plans Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/floor-plans-perth.html): $159 to 140m2, $199 for 140–270m2, $219 for 270–370m2, $219 plus $1 per m2 above 370m2. Every floor plan includes a free 360° interior virtual tour; add the exterior for $69. Redraw with site plan $45, 3D floor plan add-on $60. Measured on site.
- [Twilight and day-to-dusk photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/twilight-photography-perth.html): Shot twilight $75 as an add-on, digital day-to-dusk conversion from $1.50 per image.
- [Virtual staging Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/virtual-staging-perth.html): Staging, decluttering, object removal, day-to-dusk and rain cleanup from $1.50 per image, rendered in two to five minutes.
- [3D virtual tours Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/virtual-tours-perth.html): $159 for an interactive 360-degree tour inside and out, any size property. Every floor plan also includes a free interior tour.
- [Rental property photography Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/rental-property-photography-perth.html): $159 per property, up to 25 images, multiple properties scheduled as a run.
- [Real estate agent headshots Perth](https://www.bakerproduction.com/agent-headshots-perth.html): $189 for one agent, fully edited.
